description: This file defines a command-line interface (CLI) for managing a node host service, including commands to run, check status, install, uninstall, stop, and restart the service. It uses the 'commander' library for CLI command definitions and imports various functions for executing these commands.

methods.name: parsePortWithFallback
methods.description: Parses a port value, falling back to a default if parsing fails.

methods.name: registerNodeCli
methods.description: Sets up CLI commands for managing the node host service.
